title: AAPL Stock: Why Apple Inc. Benefits From the Tech Backlash
text: AAPL Stock: Why Apple Inc. Benefits From the Tech Backlash "Techlash" Threatens Most Tech StocksEver since the term "fake news" entered the zeitgeist, public opinion has turned against Silicon Valley's most famous inhabitants.Customers are upset at Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) for its abuse of private data, at Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOG)-aka Google-for its secret deals with the Pentagon, and at salesforce.com, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) for providing support to border protection agencies.But despite this barrage of anti-tech sentiment, one company remains unscathed: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL).
